title: 500 Hours Hit YouTube Every Minute
description:
Could you watch just one minute of YouTube uploads?

Sources:
- Tubefilter: More than 500 hours of content are now being uploaded to YouTube every minute (May 7 2019): https://www.tubefilter.com/2019/05/07/number-hours-video-uploaded-to-youtube-per-minute/
- Wikipedia: YouTube: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube

YouTube said in 2019 that more than 500 hours of video are uploaded every minute: 30,000 hours an hour and 720,000 hours a day, about 82.2 years of video every day (Tubefilter's math). 500 hours = about 21 days nonstop (our math). Not financial advice.

#shorts #youtube #whatif #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you scroll past a video, ask yourself:
cta: Long videos or Shorts? Comment below.

scenes.narration: Could you watch just one minute of YouTube uploads?
Over 500 hours went up every minute, YouTube said in 2019.
Watching nonstop, that one minute still takes almost three weeks.
Then try one day of uploads. 720,000 hours.
That's 82 years of video. From just one day.
Not even a whole lifetime is enough.
